overview: Overlapping subproblems + optimal substructure. LCS, LIS, subset-sum, matrix-chain/rod-cutting, recurrence table.
coreConcept: Subproblem define karo, recurrence likho, table bharo (bottom-up).
hinglishExplanation: DP me bade problem ko chhote overlapping subproblems me todte hain aur answers table me store karte hain. LCS: match par diagonal +1, warna max(up, left). Subset-sum: T[i][s] = T[i-1][s] or T[i-1][s-a_i].
formalDefinition: Subproblem define karo, recurrence likho, table bharo (bottom-up).
importantProperties: LCS: T[i][j]=T[i-1][j-1]+1 if match else max(T[i-1][j],T[i][j-1]).
LIS in O(n^2) DP, O(n log n) with patience.
